```{r}
# SERVER
current_guess <- reactiveVal(NULL)

output$show_rating <- reactive({
  show_rating()
})

outputOptions(output, "show_rating", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)

show_rating <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

# Map
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  leaflet() %>% addTiles() %>% setView(lng=0, lat=20, zoom=2)
})

# Map click
observeEvent(input$map_click, {
  lat <- input$map_click$lat
  lng <- input$map_click$lng
  current_guess(c(lat=lat, lng=lng))
  leafletProxy("map") %>% clearMarkers() %>% addMarkers(lng=lng, lat=lat)
  output$info <- renderPrint({ paste("📍 Selected location:", round(lat,4), round(lng,4)) })
})

# Submit guess
observeEvent(input$submit_guess, {
  guess <- current_guess()
  username <- input$username
  if(is.null(guess)){ output$info <- renderPrint({"❌ Click on the map first!"}); return() }
  if(is.null(username) || username==""){ output$info <- renderPrint({"❌ Please enter a username!"}); return() }

  # Save temporary guess
# Create unique submission ID
submission_id <- paste0(
  username,
  "_",
  as.integer(Sys.time())
)

new_row <- data.frame(
  submission_id = submission_id,
  username = username,
  lat = guess["lat"],
  lng = guess["lng"],
  timestamp = Sys.time(),
  beauty = NA,
  uniqueness = NA,
  difficulty = NA
)

tryCatch({

  # Save guess immediately
  sheet_append(sheet_id, new_row)

  # Store ID for optional later rating
  submitted_guess_id <<- submission_id

  # Show rating panel optionally
  show_rating(TRUE)

  output$info <- renderPrint({

    paste(
      "✅ Guess submitted!",
      "\n⭐ Optional: Rate this round below."
    )
  })

}, error = function(e){

  output$info <- renderPrint({
    paste("❌ Submission failed:", e$message)
  })

})
})

# Submit ratings + final save
# Submit optional ratings
# Submit optional ratings
observeEvent(input$submit_rating, {

  username <- input$username

  if(is.null(username) || username == "") {

    output$info <- renderPrint({
      "❌ Username missing."
    })

    return()
  }

  rating_row <- data.frame(

    username = username,

    beauty <- as.numeric(sub("★", "", input$beauty)),
uniqueness <- as.numeric(sub("★", "", input$uniqueness)),
difficulty <- as.numeric(sub("★", "", input$difficulty)),

    timestamp = Sys.time()
  )

  tryCatch({

    sheet_append(
      ss = sheet_id,
      data = rating_row,
      sheet = ratings_sheet
    )

    show_rating(FALSE)

    output$info <- renderPrint({

      paste(
        "⭐ Ratings submitted successfully!"
      )
    })

  }, error = function(e){

    output$info <- renderPrint({
      paste("❌ Rating submission failed:", e$message)
    })

  })
})
```
